note: Core capability registry for the initial lead-generation toolkit. These tools are intentionally server-scoped and shareable across runtimes.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for business, company, and market information using a query.

tools.name: web_news_search
tools.description: Search recent news and press coverage for a company, sector, or market trend.

tools.name: maps_search_places
tools.description: Find businesses and places by text query and optional geography.

tools.name: maps_nearby_search
tools.description: Discover nearby businesses around a point or geocoded address.

tools.name: company_directory_search
tools.description: Search business directories and local company listings for relevant entities across region and country scopes.

tools.name: person_directory_search
tools.description: Search professional and people directories for founders, executives, and decision-makers by company, role, and geography.

tools.name: public_records_search
tools.description: Search public registries and structured company datasets for registrations and ownership signals.

tools.name: marketplace_search
tools.description: Search marketplaces and platform listings for demand-side or commercial activity.

tools.name: events_search
tools.description: Search communities and events for activity signals relevant to early-stage or scaling businesses.

tools.name: signal_monitoring
tools.description: Monitor trigger events like hiring, fundraising, or launch activity for a target company.

tools.name: website_research
tools.description: Assess a domain for website structure, technology stack, and product signal evidence.

tools.name: website_content_research
tools.description: Extract product, service, proof, and CTA signals from a company website.

tools.name: website_technology_scan
tools.description: Assess a domain for website structure, technology stack, and product signal evidence.

tools.name: enrich_company
tools.description: Look up a company and return registration, firmographic, and ownership metadata.

tools.name: enrich_person
tools.description: Enrich a person record with role, social profile, and contact metadata.

tools.name: detect_technologies
tools.description: Inspect a website to identify technologies, stack components, and platform signals.

tools.name: competitive_intelligence_search
tools.description: Search for competitive signals, adjacent-market activity, and seller readiness indicators.

tools.name: crm_upsert_lead
tools.description: Upsert a lead record in the SaaS CRM using a tenant-specific integration endpoint and raw JSON request body.

tools.name: yellow_pages_business_lookup
tools.description: Fallback directory-style business contact lookup when a paid enrichment provider returns no usable email or contact data.

tools.name: yellow_pages_person_lookup
tools.description: Fallback person lookup by company, name, or domain using the first configured directory-style provider.

tools.name: lead_scoring
tools.description: Score and rank a set of leads using a placeholder weighting model that will evolve over time.
